t: What Robot Grasping Database Is All About
title: What Robot Grasping Database Is All About
description: Robot grasping matches gripper to object: parallel jaws for boxes, suction for flat/smooth, soft/three-finger for irregular. Grasp quality (force closure, Ferrari-Canny metric) predicts success; friction, weight, and center of mass decide. Datasets (YCB objects) benchmark. The rule: know the object, choose the gripper, plan the contact — then measure success. This database is the complete grasp record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
